errors.evidence: The pie chart consists of six sectors.
The sector 'Да, веднъж годишно' is approximately 26.7%.
The sector 'Не се провежда' is approximately 20%, not the smallest sector.
No sectors are labeled in gray; they are all purple shades.
The description claims a legend is present, but the chart does not include a legend.
